title: Component-First Architecture on Frontend
desc: If 2+ pages share the exact same UI element (button, card, table, modal), build it immediately as a component inside components/. Make it reusable by passing dynamic data via props instead of hardcoding text.
doThis: Export a reusable <Modal title={title} isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose}>{children}</Modal>
dontDoThis: Duplicate 50 lines of HTML modal layout inside 4 separate page components.

title: Service Layer, Never Direct Fetching in Pages
desc: All API requests must pass through services/. When an endpoint changes or error handling needs updating, you only modify a single service file instead of touching every page view.
doThis: Call userService.getUsers() in component, where userService handles baseURL, headers, and error toasts.
dontDoThis: Call fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users', { headers: ... }) directly inside page useEffect hooks.

title: Constants File for All Magic Values
desc: Roles (admin, staff, client), status labels (pending, approved, rejected), and fixed dropdown options belong in constants/—never inline. Hardcoded magic strings are the #1 cause of messy AI-generated code.
doThis: Reference USER_ROLES.ADMIN or STATUS_CODES.PENDING from src/constants/index.js
dontDoThis: Hardcode strings like if (user.role === 'admin_user') or status === 'Pending Approval' scattered in 10 files.

title: Environment Config Driven by .env
desc: Database credentials, API URLs, and mail server settings belong in .env. Always commit a .env.example template so any new developer can set up their machine immediately.
doThis: const API_URL = process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL; always commit .env.example with placeholders.
dontDoThis: Commit real database passwords or hardcode http://192.168.1.5:8000 inside source code.

title: A Single Master schema.sql Kept Updated
desc: Keep a master schema.sql synced so when deploying to a new server or onboarding a client, you can import the entire database cleanly without recreating tables by hand.
doThis: Keep database/schema.sql synced with every migration so a clean import builds the entire DB instantly.
dontDoThis: Rely on memory or manual phpMyAdmin edits without exporting a master SQL snapshot.

title: Consistent Naming Conventions Across Projects
desc: Always use controllers, services, and routes regardless of the stack. Predictable naming means any team member or AI tool knows exactly where to locate and modify code.
doThis: Maintain uniform folder conventions across all company repositories.
dontDoThis: Name folders 'handlers' in Project A, 'api_endpoints' in Project B, and 'backend_logic' in Project C.
